scope: Matched within-browser alternating builds; 390x844 CSS/DPR3/deviceMemory hint4; synthetic actual pen input, SwiftShader, physical phone and scanout unmeasured
limitations: The1100-short and100-long completion tests explicitly pace admission at the existing application limit; they do not establish uninterrupted fixed10Hz acceptance. Every pacing wait is reported. Fixed offered200-stroke capacity is reported separately.

At the preview memory limit the last complete image is retained while formal work drains, with an explicit status. Accepted input is retained; temporary display delay under this overload is not a smoothness success.
A submission-completion proxy is not physical display latency.
Warm-up is separately reported; cold/new-document outliers remain in raw evidence.
Three balanced trials per1/2/4/8/16/32/64px condition; scaling/broad controls have one per build.
First-input latency and high-percentile outliers may remain even when medians improve.
Cold Undo outside the bounded history cache still reconstructs.
Already submitted GPU work cannot be cancelled.
